scope: Fixed local source of llama.cpp, ik_llama.cpp, TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang and current Hyle public APIs. No network update, build, GPU run or new session implementation in this research.
conclusion: Separate logical context, retained sessions, active sequences and aggregate cache/state bytes. Let the engine derive preparation domains and resource capacities from semantic user controls; Hyle supplies bounded state/page/plan/execution mechanisms.

engine_controls.name: context_per_sequence
engine_controls.meaning: Logical history per continuable sequence; not physical cache pool size.

engine_controls.name: cached_sessions
engine_controls.meaning: Retained idle plus active continuation entries; not active execution slots.

engine_controls.name: active_sequences
engine_controls.meaning: Combined actively scheduled distinct sequences; not number of users or in-flight batches.

engine_controls.name: cache_budget_bytes
engine_controls.meaning: Managed all-layer KV, recurrent/conv, copy-on-write and retained-version backing; not total process GPU memory.

automatic_or_optional.memory_budget: Optional host/device operating budgets with explicit unknown provider bytes and headroom.
automatic_or_optional.step_tokens: Auto chosen new query tokens per step, distinct from retained history.
automatic_or_optional.inflight_batches: Auto chosen independent mutable execution slots, each charged to the real resource budget.
automatic_or_optional.prepared_step_sizes: Auto chosen finite hot shapes; explicit preparation outside the ready domain.

engine: Admission, queueing, eviction and exact prefix matching
Batching, token/position/model semantics, generation and MTP acceptance policy
hyle: Actual dtype/layout/state/effect contracts and cold capability/route selection
Bounded page permissions, state versions, explicit copy-on-write and native retirement
Shared immutable plans, independent mutable invocations, preparation reports and explicit capacity failures

important_limits: These names are design terms, not newly available Hyle flags or compulsory user settings.
Capacity planning does not guarantee TPS, prevent all native layout replans, or reserve physical VRAM against drivers and other processes.
A known bounded KV token pool alone is insufficient for hybrid recurrent/conv models. Current Qwen has 19537920 bytes of conv/GDN state per version before KV and other ownership costs.
vLLM total-GPU executor utilization, SGLang weights-plus-KV static fraction and TensorRT-LLM currently-free-memory KV fraction use different denominators.
A session-directory eviction or cancellation cannot reclaim storage still pinned by results, state versions or native execution.
Finite shapes and stable addresses are insufficient to prove capture reuse; native layout topology and resource identities still apply.
Source research is not new measured performance. Existing current multi-turn measurements remain separate.
source_caveats: TRT-LLM checkout has extensive index/untracked changes; cited source bytes were checked against its fixed HEAD. Local CLI defaults are not asserted as latest upstream releases or as defaults in the earlier matched benchmark SDK.
